A clip posted on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/reel/1247318787817224) by Laguna Beach Unfiltered showed what was left of the tower on the rocks as the swell pounded it over and over again.
The only part that remained was the concrete base at the foot of the stairs down to the beach.

The destruction of the tower comes after part of the [Pacifica Municipal Pier](https://www.yahoo.com/news/weather-news/articles/video-shows-pacifica-pier-collapse-200017814.html) was washed away in the Bay Area.
